text:
priya: FYI — getting multiple reports that the Console Usage charts show zero token counts for some orgs even though API logs prove requests went through. Affected orgs: 67890, 67901. Ticket SUP-9876.

jordan: :eyes: can you paste a quick repro? is this only the 'Usage > Tokens' chart or other dashboards too?

priya: Only the time-series charts under Analytics -> Usage and per-model breakdowns. Funnel and quota pages look fine. Repro steps I used: 1) Login as admin for org 67890, 2) Console -> Analytics -> Usage, 3) Set range to last 90d, 4) Filter org: 67890, 5) Chart shows flat 0 tokens. Meanwhile API logs show many requests during that window.

kevin: I ran the backend query against events_ingest aggregate and got rows for org 67890:
```
SELECT count(*) FROM events WHERE org_id=67890 AND ts>='2026-01-01';
-- returns 12,432 rows
```
But the chart query (metrics_rollup) returns empty. Suspect a join on roles/permissions that filters out rows for orgs with role-based retention override.

maria: support-bot flagged an ingestion delay for tenant 67901 earlier today (ingest-delay-bot: delay 45m). Could be related but 67890 never had a delay.

support-bot: [alert] tenant 67901 ingestion delay resolved at 1763006000. Delta: 45m.

priya: I also checked retention policies: org 67890 has non-default retention: "role_based=true" set on their account metadata. Maybe the rollup job assumes a global retention table and drops rows when role_based=true. Filing ENG-INC-4321.

jordan: Assigning to eng-analytics to triage. Quick mitigation: we can re-run the nightly rollup for impacted orgs to rebuild metrics (will backfill ~48h). Priya, can you confirm a list of affected org IDs and customer contacts so we can schedule backfill?

kevin: Short repro curl if helpful: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/metrics?org=67890&range=90d` returns empty JSON but raw /v1/logs shows entries. Sending logs to ENG-INC-4321 Slack thread.

priya: Confirmed affected orgs: 67890 (Acme Retail), 67901 (BlueFin). Contacts in SUP-9876. I'll kick off emergency backfill for 67890 and monitor.

maria: If eng needs a quick patch, the failing predicate is `roles.visibility = 'public'` in the rollup join. I can share a small SQL snippet that relaxes the join to include NULL role entries.

jordan: Great. Triage notes: severity P2 (customer-facing dashboards broken, non-critical data still in logs), block: role-based retention join bug in nightly rollup. Next: eng-analytics to push hotfix and run targeted backfill. Priya — please send customer update after backfill completes. :thumbsup:
